classification: preregistered current-data reconstruction of the retired R131 dual-sleeve shape; no parameter search
decision_rule: All G1-G7 pass -> candidate_for_concentration_audit only. Any failure -> record negative knowledge; no gate, window, target, weight bounds, or rebalance change after seeing results.

execution.data_root: temporary copy of data/research/r40_engine_data with current data/kline_daily copied as the raw execution directory

gates.G1_execution: all 10 phase + 5 recent dual-sleeve runs complete with non-empty aligned equity curves
gates.G3_full_return: START full-path 2x combined+vol15 annual >= 5% and Sharpe >= 0.60
gates.G4_recent: recent mean return > 0 and at least 4/5 positive fresh-start phases
gates.G5_stress: START full-path 3x combined+vol15 return > 0 and MDD >= -30%
gates.G6_incrementality: vs B-only vol15 at START: combined+vol15 improves Sharpe by >=0.05 or MDD by >=3pp, without reducing B-only annual return by more than 2pp
gates.G7_no_leverage: all monthly total-exposure weights stay within [0,1.0]

known_limitations: R40 is a local research snapshot, not an official canonical archive.
The shape is derived from R131, which failed snapshot reproducibility; this round tests the shape on current data and does not restore old performance.
Industry mapping and alt factors may use current snapshots rather than historical PIT.
Overlapping phase starts are descriptive and are not independent out-of-sample evidence.
A standalone R266 failed stock-level concentration gates; any R312 pass still requires a separate trade/stock concentration audit.

portfolio_rule.combine: 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity; monthly rebalance; A weight bounds [0.2,0.8]
portfolio_rule.overlay: 60-day realized volatility target 15%; monthly rebalance; total exposure bounds [0.2,1.0]

question: 在 R40 可复现行情临时根目录与当前因子数据上，把宏观质量 A 腿与行业相对强弱质量 B 腿按 60 日逆波动风险平价组合，再叠加 15% 无杠杆波动率目标，能否把单腿 B 的完整路径回撤压到 -25% 内，同时保留近期稳定性、压力成本余量并优于 B-only？
